description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of  Exchange effective from 18.11.2019 to 24.11.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how financial calculations are performed for import/export transactions. The content involves legal authority (Customs Ordinance), regulatory compliance requirements, and the issuance of a statutory instrument, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory matters.
